column1: # vgp577_hg38_panel.tsv -- target-genome panel for the 577-way hg38-source
# slide benchmark.  REF (source/display genome) = hg38 = GCA_000001405.15.
# These are the 13 hg38 -> target genomes we have UCSC liftOver chains for
# (named <REF>_vs_<genome_id>.chain.gz in the chains dir).  One line per
# target.  3 columns, TAB-separated (the `-L` panel format used by the
# lift / lift-genome / blockViz bench scripts; default awk FS so
# Names resolved from the NCBI datasets v2 API (organism_name + common_name);
# GCF_902713615.1 resolved via Ensembl/NCBI assembly record (sScyCan1.1).
